description: One page of an account's trust lines, with an opaque cursor for the next page. When to use: To list every trust line of an account (balances, limits, freeze and authorization flags), page by page. Prefer another tool: For a quick capped overview with the XRP balance, use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/summary`; for issued totals of a token, use the token endpoint. Example: xrpl_account_lines {"address":"rvYAfWj5gh67oV6fW32ZzP3Aw4Eubs59B"}

address.description: Valid classic XRPL account address (r..., checksum verified)

limit.description: Lines per page: an integer from 10 to 400 (default 100)

marker.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `marker`, for the same address

peer.description: Only lines with this counterparty (classic address)

name: xrpl_account_lines

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

balance.description: Line balance in units of `currency`; positive: the peer owes the account; negative: the account owes

currency.description: Canonical currency code (3 characters or 40 hex)

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

deep_freeze.description: True when the account has deep-frozen the line

deep_freeze_peer.description: True when the peer has deep-frozen the line

headroom.description: Holder only: `line_limit` minus balance; null for an issuer

line_limit.description: Limit the account sets, in units of `currency`

peer_line_limit.description: Limit the peer sets, in units of `currency`

quality_in_multiplier.description: QualityIn as a factor (1 = unchanged): value / 1e9, absent or 0 meaning 1

quality_out_multiplier.description: QualityOut as a factor (1 = unchanged): value / 1e9, absent or 0 meaning 1

role.description: `issuer` when the balance is negative, else `holder`

marker.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (send as `marker`); null on the last page

title: Account trust lines
